licensure.disciplinary_grounds.rationale: These nine buckets map onto the dominant natural clusters across all states: fraudulent acts in obtaining licenses or deceiving patients/payers; criminal convictions; clinical negligence/malpractice/incompetence; substance abuse or physical-mental impairment; aiding unlicensed practice or improper delegation; false/deceptive advertising; improper billing, fee-splitting, and financial exploitation; sexual misconduct and immoral conduct; and a broad compliance bucket covering failure to follow statutes, board orders, reporting requirements, and infection-control or recordkeeping mandates.

profession_specific.sedation_anesthesia_.rationale: The items cluster naturally by sedation depth level (the standard continuum from minimal through moderate/conscious to deep to general anesthesia), with nitrous oxide/analgesia as a distinct pharmacologic category, pediatric-specific endorsements as a cross-cutting credential modifier, and a small residual bucket for generic or administrative entries (permits, certificates, registration) that name a credential type without specifying a sedation level.
